biggest_catch: Appen publishes no platform pay rate — appen.com posts jobs without rates; pay is set per project and only shown inside the tool after you are accepted.
catches: Reported $3–$20/hr and $8–$25/hr figures are third-party estimates, not official Appen terms.
Approval can take 2–3 months before a first long-term paid project is available.
Per-task rates (e.g., $0.10/judgment examples on third-party job mirrors) are not official terms and vary by project and country.
Payoneer-based payouts; monthly invoicing reported by third parties — not confirmed on official pages.
